notes.title: 1.30.6 Drift Hotfix
notes.content:
- Fixed drift detection for "Drift King" and "What Do you Mean Drift?" achievements


PC ONLY
- Added secret/experimental option to allow for overriding the skybox the game uses.
[spoiler]For example, if you want a more realistic "stars only" one, you can use skybox 19!
To do so, head to [code]AppData\LocalLow\CatCommandosLtd\Space Docker VR\Config\ShipConfig.json[/code] and add/edit the line:
[code]"overrideSkyboxIndex": -1,[/code]
(Replace -1 with the number skybox you want to always use. List can be [url=https://imgur.com/a/KvhZM12]seen here[/url] - the numbers they use are on the left and range from 0 to 28)
It's a bit experimental, so be wary that Steam Cloud may try to overwrite it automatically - and make sure to make a back-up of these files before manually editing them, just in case.[/spoiler]

notes.title: Huge Summer Update!
notes.content:
[h2]This one's a big one! [/h2]
We've been working on this patch for the past few months, and some of the headliners include new difficulty settings for the novice pilot, as well as a host of graphical and Quality-of-Life fixes.
Read more below:

[h2]New Graphics[/h2][list]
[*][b]Better thruster VFX[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41559448/5e7240852dae09910a7e348edcfeef2edbe7bcad.gif[/img]

[*][b]“Glow Zones” to illuminate crates and the cockpit[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41559448/2c3ced5c521a45fd1249635257bfbe16db5611da.gif[/img]

[*][b]CRT style displays[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41559448/d3e42e78504e12674f897ff6263bde9a315a8601.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41559448/dccf86e983f3b4973a7735930c460199b08ef802.gif[/img]

[*][b]V2 Leaderboards[/b]
Leaderboards will now show extra info, such as platform, assist levels, and if HOTAS/Controller hardware was used.
(Note: V1 scores will be converted upon loading game)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41559448/b505547d84dda63dcdc41ea6bb3d07c3360a47f7.png[/img]

[*][b]Expanded Difficulty Options[/b]
Do you need Auto-braking to keep you from drifting into deep space? or perhaps a lite-auto-pilot to help you follow moving cargo, we’ve added these as optional “position assists”.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41559448/c4be92215a38c9011219e0dfefe2103ca2f03731.png[/img]

[*][b]Subtitles[/b]
Featuring settings like adjustable scale, speaker colors, speaker names, and a “bionic” mode.

(previous versions have been moved to “Unpaid Overtime” levels section)

[*][b]Level Descriptions[/b]
[*][b]New Tutorial Mission[/b]
[*][b]Animated Garage Door[/b]
[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life Improvements[/h2][list]
[*][b]Better braking feedback[/b]
The velocity indicator now shows handbrake and auto-braking thrust in red segments
[*][b]Virtual Axes (Joysticks) only show movement from bound axes[/b]
[*][b]Added text that lets you know which “time to beat” you’re currently on (out of Silver, Gold, or Developer time)[/b]
[*][b]Lowered proportion of nukes in procedural levels[/b]
[*][b]Additional voice lines in “Rock Lobster” to give better feedback [/b]
[*][b]Various Performance improvements[/b]
[*][b]Fixed TV visual/audio sync issue[/b]
[*][b]Various small bug-fixes[/b]
[/list]
[h2]Quest Release[/h2]
We’re also now on [url=https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/4149586988452190/]Meta’s AppLab![/url]

[h2]The Future[/h2]
We’re always looking to improve the game, and your feedback is invaluable!
If you want to help us with that, or if you just want to come hang out with your fellow dockers, we’ve got a link to our discord below:

notes.title: HOTAS Beta Update
notes.content:
We want to make the best possible VR space-sim experience, and for that, we need physical controller support.

[h2][b]We've added beta HOTAS Support![/b][/h2]

WIP State of HOTAS / Physical Controllers:

What does work:
[list]
[*] Rebind any current input that virtual cockpit users have to a HOTAS / Physical controller device.
[*] Bind "bonus action" just for HOTAS users currently.
[*] Missions+Game are completely playable in HOTAS + motion controllers.
[/list]
What doesn't work yet:
[list]
[*] For the moment, there's no menu control, so you'll still have to use your hands for that. But once in a mission, there should be no need for hands again.
[*] Currently, the binding is done via an overlay on the desktop view - so no in-VR menu.
We believe this is a good compromise, as it's a familiar interface, and mouse input should work better for this sort-of "busy" UI compared to a VR pointer.
[*] No default layouts - Dockers will have to bind to their preferences from a blank slate. Fortunately, there aren't many binds in-total
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41559448/6fc6d842097183f6a7271a0804046d02fedf898c.png[/img]

And we've made a video that goes over the basics of rebinding, some tips of what to look out for when doing this, as well as some bonus footage showing off the gameplay:
[previewyoutube=xOK6dienFPM;full][/previewyoutube]

If you have any game-breaking issues with the build, you can opt into the "previous_patch" branch on the Steam betas tab.

[url=https://discord.gg/N4keTnEKtC] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41559448/73d3d9ebce7f685ee614da33f552e0e0185f9cd4.png[/img][/url]

Stay tuned on Discord our for more updates, including an upcoming roadmap for future updates!

notes.title: Space-Handbrake Update!
notes.content:
Good news! We've added a space-handbrake to help our "new hires" start their docking career!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41559448/ec747da03961543c283f8517a4050537b1261ebf.gif[/img]

The space-handbrake works by having the appropriate thrusters fire to help slow you to a near stop.

But for those looking for an extra challenge, or looking to eek out the most performance out of their ship, we've added some higher difficulty options related to rotational assists!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41559448/9fc2a5fcb7f9bb86a7a54737190d0d04394ac23b.png[/img]


We're still hard at work adding HOTAS support, as well as other new features and content.
In order to best keep up to date with what we're doing, as well as have a say, by voting for what you want to see added to the game next, [url=https://discord.gg/qDQcKrad6G]come join our Discord! [/url]
